note: Measured real-world values the maps are checked against (user, 27 Nov 2026: the outside reference is the real places). Albedo = broadband diffuse reflectance (0-1, linear); a surface's rendered base colour should land inside its range. Sources below each entry.

asphalt-worn.note: aged AC and aged chip seal ~0.12 (LBNL)

rock.note: red sandstone sits low in this range and strongly red: check hue against the photos

pinyon-juniper.note: whole woodland incl. ground between trees, SW Utah (Gifford 1973); canopy alone darker, conifer-like

dielectric-srgb.note: no non-metal base colour darker than 30-50 or brighter than 240 sRGB

plantCover.note: canopy cover targets for the plant census (tools/reference/plant_census.py), percent of ground area

sagebrush.source: Davies et al. 2006, Rangeland Ecology & Management 59(6): 107 intact Wyoming big sagebrush communities, mean sagebrush cover 12.3%, 90% of sites 6–20%

sagebrushColoradoPlateau.source: USGS NVC CEGL002775 (Wyoming big sagebrush / muttongrass, northern Colorado Plateau): shrub layer ~10% on hot dry sites, >50% sheltered

pinyonJuniperTrees.source: NRCS ecological site R048AY342UT: tree canopy 15–30% is the diverse woodland phase; >30% understory and diversity at their lowest
